_readme: No MCP servers are required. Claude Code's built-in WebSearch and WebFetch cover every research skill in this repo, and Gmail / Google Calendar / Google Drive / Slack are connected as claude.ai connectors. Full picture: .claude/connections.md

_already_connected_via_claude_ai._note: Available in the Claude desktop app and Cowork WITHOUT any entry here. Do NOT duplicate them into mcpServers — that wires a second, unauthenticated path to the same service.
_already_connected_via_claude_ai._google_meet: Meet recordings and transcripts save to the organiser's Google Drive, so the Drive connector already reaches them. This is the input for /win-loss-analysis.

_wekan_stack_no_mcp_available._note: Checked against the connector registry 2026-08-31: NO MCP connector exists for any of these. All have REST APIs — reach them through an n8n / Make webhook bridge, with the human review gate from marketing/rules/escalation.md in front. Do not invent package names for them.

smartlead.path: REST API via n8n/Make, or paste

_optional_verify_before_use._note: Not part of the WeKan stack today. Package names NOT verified — run `npm view <package> version` before promoting anything here into mcpServers.

gsc._when: Only once SEO work starts. Until wired, /seo-strategy returns [UNAVAILABLE] for search volumes and says so.

exa._when: Optional. Overlaps origami.chat, and built-in WebSearch/WebFetch already cover this repo's research skills. See the Exa vs origami.chat note in .claude/connections.md before wiring.

_retired._note: Assumed by the upstream quickstart, NOT in the WeKan stack. Removed deliberately — do not reference these in skills or agents.

_wiring_priority: 1. Nothing — the research layer runs today on built-in WebSearch/WebFetch
2. Confirm Google Meet transcription is ON — unlocks /win-loss-analysis via the Drive connector
3. Google Search Console — only when SEO work actually starts
4. n8n/Make bridge — only when SmartLead or HeyReach go live
5. Exa — only if a free-tier trial beats origami.chat on something specific
